retoken: 早乙女 -> 早乙女#getter in every Getter Robo Armageddon entry: pilot 269 CHFN and CHNN, pilot 267 DSCR/DSC2 ('Professor $$早乙女$$'s daughter'), pilot 272 and 273 DSCR ('together with $$早乙女$$ and $$敷島$$'), keyword 87 DSCR ('Dr. $$早乙女$$'), keyword 90 DSCR (two uses), and any other of the 30 Getter-series uses. Leave the 8 uses in the Macross F movie entries (Alto Saotome's family) as plain 早乙女. English is 'Saotome' either way, so this only matters for the pilot 269 record (male Getter professor) versus the Kabuki family.
インベーダー: already split (インベーダー#robot for the species in prose, インベーダー#pilot for pilot 274 CHNN); no further change. Pilot 274 CHFN should stay コーウェン＆スティンガー#pilot.

ナバロン: akurasu Master list says 'Navaron' (used); Jigoku library 'Navarone'; en Wikipedia 'Nabalon'. Gender of ナバロン / 梅本 is not stated anywhere (謎に包まれた人): profile says unknown, so translators must stay gender-neutral.

ドン・ザウサー: akurasu uses both 'Don Zauser' and 'Don Zauther'; chose 'Don Zauser' (matches ザウサー, en Wikipedia primary spelling, Daitarn page character list, Alpha 2 / A). Don's gender is unknown from the text (only a cyborg head with visible brain); Koros calls him 'Don'.
ギャリソン時田: akurasu and en Wikipedia say 'Tokida'; ja Wikipedia gives the reading ときた (Tokita). Followed akurasu.
コーウェン: Z3.2 mech list and Wikipedia 'Cowen'; Master list and Z2 story translation 'Cohen'. Used Cowen (matches the already-official glossary unit 'Cowen & Stinger').
ゴール＆ブライ: gender left unknown (a pair of clones; no pronoun); earlier proposal 'Gore & Bly' changed to 'Gore & Burai' (akurasu Master list, Wikipedia).

元気 / 早乙女元気: glossary kind for 元気 is keyword but it is a girl's name (same person as 渓 Kei); kept the kind as the rules say. Kei's given English 'Kei' collides with 桂 Kei Katsuragi (Orguss) but the Japanese differs, so no retoken.
戸田突太 is 'Totta Toda' (ja Wikipedia reading とった; akurasu Master list), not 'Toppo Toda' as the earlier proposal had it.

The Z3.2 pilot database (rank 2) covers only Banjo Haran, Watta Takeo, Umemaro Kakikouji and the first Getter/Dancouga pilots; most names here rest on akurasu's Master Characters List (rank 3) and Wikipedia. Wikipedia-only names: 道太郎 Michitaro, 創造 / 破嵐創造 Sozo (Haran), ロボット帝国 Robot Empire, ノヴァライノス Nova Rhino.
Shared names with super_2 / super_3 / other briefs: none found (checked every name against all other briefs). 早乙女 overlaps only by English with the Macross F family (see retoken).
